notes: As the closed tunnel case, with duct leakage (Lc = 20 m³/s per km at 1 kPa, a station every 20 m). The duct loses air along its length: inlet mass = outlet mass + leakage mass. In the tunnel the return grows toward the duct inlet as each leak adds its air: at the duct inlet end the tunnel carries the full inlet mass, at the outlet end only the outlet mass.

expected.basis: continuity at every duct and tunnel node
